details:
Something that has always bothered me was the distinct and massive difference between how the running animations look when in FBT compared to 3/4p tracking. Now that FBT got option to essentially lock Head/Hip to emulate what 3/4p tracking has, i'd like a reverse option for 3/4p tracking that allows to use the FBT IK while in 3/4p tracking. Not only does running and walking look a lot better, the FBT IK also seems to activate immediately after stopping unlike 3/4p tracking which needs 1-2 seconds before your legs start using IK.
Since FBT users don't seem to have their hips match up while walking/running most of the time anyway (making some avatars run in a hunched over position and making the head/hip lock desired in some cases) i don't see why FBT would be required to use its IK while running in 3/4p tracking.
An option to turn this on (just like FBT can essentially turn it off now) would be greatly appreciated.
title: [Feedback/Request] Being able to use FBT IK while in 3/4p tracking
